spot.html_text: In yet another sense Anti-Haecceitism is the thesis that the identity of objects is reducible to their pure properties. One minimal condition of the identity of objects’ being reducible to their pure properties is that, for every possible object, having certain pure properties is a necessarily sufficient condition for being that particular object. spot.html_text: There is a possible world with objects that share almost all their pure properties. If there is a possible world with objects that share almost all their pure properties, there is a possible world with objects that share all their pure properties. Therefore, there is a possible world with objects that share all their pure properties.
